items.title: Lume 0.2 – Build and Run macOS VMs with unattended setup
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, Lume is an open-source CLI for running macOS and Linux VMs on Apple Silicon. Since launch ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=42908061 ), we've been using it to run AI agents in isolated macOS environments. We needed VMs that could set themselves up, so we built that. Here's what's new in 0.2: *Unattended Setup* – Go from IPSW to a fully configured VM without touching the keyboard. We built a VNC + OCR system that clicks through macOS Setup Assistant automatically. No more manual setup before pushing to a registry: lume create my-vm --os macos --ipsw latest --unattended tahoe You can write custom YAML configs to set up any macOS version your way. *HTTP API + Daemon* – A REST API on port 7777 that runs as a background service.
